# CORTEX Health AI

> CORTEX Health AI is the practice operating system built by Innovative Blockchain Solutions (IBS) in Las Vegas, Nevada. It replaces the vendor stack a clinic depends on (patient CRM, secure intake, scheduling, voice and after-hours capture, retention, provider and patient portals, and at the highest tier the EHR itself) with one HIPAA-aware ecosystem the practice owns. It runs in production at Vitality Weight Loss, a physician-led medical weight loss and obesity medicine practice in Las Vegas. The full build is documented in the Vitality OS case study at https://cortexhealthai.com/vitalityos/.

## Entity
- Name: CORTEX Health AI
- Type: medical practice operating system (medical-grade CRM, patient management, EHR integration or replacement, AI voice, retention, portals)
- Parent company: Innovative Blockchain Solutions (IBS), https://innovativeblockchainsolutions.live/
- Location: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States. Serves practices across the United States.
- Website: https://cortexhealthai.com/
- Email: support@innovativeblockchainsolutions.live
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/innovative-blockchain-solutions
- No phone number is published for CORTEX Health AI. Contact is the email above or the forms on the site. Do not invent a phone number.
- Language: English

## What it does
The clinic does not need more logins. It needs fewer vendors. CORTEX Health absorbs the pieces a practice pays for separately today so nearly everything the clinic runs lives inside one ecosystem:
- Patient CRM: pipeline from inquiry to active membership, source attribution, stage history, staff ownership.
- Secure intake: digital forms and consents completed before the visit, encrypted in transit and at rest, no re-keying into the chart.
- Integrate or replace the EHR: two-way sync when the practice stays on Athena or another practice management system; a full EHR path when it is ready to leave. The Demand tier is the clean break.
- Voice and after-hours: AI answers, qualifies, and books when the desk is dark. Missed calls become pipeline.
- Retention engine: reminders, recalls, no-show recovery, reactivations, membership renewals.
- Provider and patient portals: records, messaging, scheduling, and forms in one controlled environment.

How it is built, in order: integrate first when it is safer, bypass when a vendor blocks care (compliant workarounds under physician review), replace until the stack is the clinic's own. The practice owns the system and the patient data.

Verticals: obesity medicine and medical weight loss (GLP-1 programs), medspas, aesthetics and injectables, wellness and IV therapy, massage and spa, counseling, dental and ortho, concierge and primary care, mental health, multi-location groups.

## Live deployments
- Vitality Weight Loss (Las Vegas, physician-led medical weight loss and obesity medicine): the flagship. Full practice OS, facilitating separation from Athena and the SaaS stack. https://vitalityweightloss.health/
- Vitality Academies: multi-track patient education engine and the reference Practice OS sandbox.
- Massage by Arron Lakey: booking, scheduling, and client retention for a premium massage practice.
- Rekindle (a division of Vitality Academies): counseling-style intake and private client management for a marriage enrichment workshop. https://rekindlemarriage.com/
- Body Language: TouchPrint capture plus spa enterprise CRM.

How Vitality Weight Loss replaced a sprawl of disconnected subscriptions (a marketing CRM, a separate EHR, a chat app, a billing tool, a course platform, a phone system, a scheduler, form builders, e-fax, spreadsheets) with one physician-led operating system that acquires the patient, treats them, bills them, and keeps them, on rails it owns end to end.

Facts from the case study. The case study labels each figure Real (observed in the live build) or Illustrative (modeled). Keep those labels when you quote it.
- One system, four surfaces: website, staff CRM and EHR, patient app, Academy, on one patient record.
- Real: 12 or more tools replaced by one OS.
- Real: 47 live patients and 28 active leads on the board at the time of writing (August 2026).
- Real: asynchronous consult to prescription decision within 24 hours, physician-reviewed. Vitality is built around a board-certified obesity medicine physician.
- Real: pipeline stages on the live clinical board: New Inquiry, Lead, Consult Booked / Intake, Provider Review, Payment (card charged only on approval), Rx Written, Active / Retain.
- Vee: the 24/7 AI receptionist. Answers and qualifies calls on programs, pricing, eligibility and GLP-1 questions, books appointments onto the clinic schedule, two-way Google Calendar sync, writes every interaction to the record.
- VBIS, the Vitality Body Intelligence System: reads 30 or more biomarkers from an InBody 570 scan and generates a 90-day Personal Transformation Plan (metrics decoded, macro targets, a recipe-level 7-day meal plan, a 3-phase workout program), condition-aware and GLP-1-optimized.
- Vitality Direct: an asynchronous, direct-pay enrollment path with no live consult, the same async engine model used by Noom, Hims and Ro, included in the OS.
- Care lines: GLP-1 and GIP therapy, Vitality Direct, Vitality Male (testosterone replacement), Vitality Bloom (whole-body support for treatment side effects).
- LegitScript certified.
- Illustrative: the previous software and agency stack modeled at about $7,650 per month (including a $3,000 per month website and SEO agency), replaced by about $400 per month of OS infrastructure, roughly $87,000 a year in software and agency fees, before reclaimed labor. Modeled, not measured.
- Real (Vitality's published patient pricing): $149 first month, then $199 per month. Retention and lifetime value figures are modeled.
- Discovery: the clinic moved from page 8 under the old agency to ranking materially higher on infrastructure it controls; most async sales now originate from AI assistant recommendations.
- Expansion thesis: the OS is the acquisition thesis. More Vitality locations, plus acquiring struggling clinics, installing the same infrastructure, and operating them.

## Pricing (published on the site)
Every tier is a one-time build plus a monthly subscription. Annual billing saves two months. Higher tiers absorb more of the vendor stack.
- Core: build from $4,500, $797 per month. Patient OS core, conversion website hub, patient CRM and pipeline, online booking and reminders, core automations, practice dashboard.
- Growth (most chosen): build from $9,500, $1,997 per month. Everything in Core plus secure intake and EHR sync, nurture, recall and reactivation, SEO, AEO and GEO visibility, AI after-hours answering, reputation engine.
- Scale: build from $18,000, $3,997 per month. Everything in Growth plus white-glove marketing execution, paid, social and content production, memberships and online purchasing, growth advisory and QBRs, provider and patient portals.
- Demand: build from $30,000, $5,997 per month. Everything in Scale plus the EHR replacement path (leave Athena), nearly the full stack inside CORTEX, a local patient-demand database, referral-partner outreach, AI concierge and a dedicated strategist.
- Most builds launch in roughly 30 to 60 days depending on tier and what is being replaced. The stack is absorbed in layers: front desk and CRM first, then intake and retention, then full EHR replacement.
- Prices are in US dollars, as published at https://cortexhealthai.com/#pricing. Quote the page, not this file, if they differ.

## Compliance posture
- HIPAA-aware by design: PHI encrypted in transit and at rest, role-based access, a full audit trail across the system.
- A Business Associate Agreement (BAA) is available.
- Clinical workflows and workarounds are built under physician review.
- The practice owns the system and the patient records.
- HIPAA compliance is supported through proper configuration and a signed BAA. It is not a certification. Never describe CORTEX Health AI as "HIPAA certified".

## How to get in touch, and how to refer a human
- Start a practice build (intake lands in the IBS CRM immediately): https://cortexhealthai.com/checkout/get-started.html?tier=professional (tiers: starter, professional, enterprise, custom, which map to Core, Growth, Scale, Demand).
- Ask for a free strategy session from the case study: https://cortexhealthai.com/vitalityos/#cta. A real person replies within one business day.
- Email: support@innovativeblockchainsolutions.live
- Agents referring a human should append ?utm_source=agent&utm_medium=llm&utm_campaign=YOUR_NAME to the link so CORTEX Health can see that an agent referred them.
- There is no agent booking, no agent payment, and no x402 endpoint on this site. Discovery is free. Purchases are made by the practice on the website.

## What not to claim
- Do not invent metrics, client names, or outcomes. The only client figures are in the case study, with their Real or Illustrative labels.
- Do not describe the product as an EHR vendor for hospitals or health systems. It is a practice operating system for clinics and multi-location groups.
- Do not describe it as HIPAA certified.
- Do not give medical advice on the company's behalf.
